title: check reports a gate an agent answered before a rule change made it blocking as a warning for the operator, not an error that stops every session's push gate
goal: backlog.py check reports, on an open item, a gate an agent answered while its disposition was not block and that a later rule now derives as block, as a warning naming it for the operator's re-confirmation (as it does for a closed item), not as an error, so a landing of a rule change does not stop the sync gate of every session with such an item; a gate an agent answers after the rule is in force stays an error.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os,json; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","src/a.py").stdout.split()[2]; r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question","Which wording?","--option","a","--option","b","--recommendation","a"); r("answer",i,"g1","--provisional"); f=[os.path.join(d,"_backlog",x) for x in os.listdir(os.path.join(d,"_backlog")) if x.startswith(i)][0]; j=json.load(open(f)); j["gates"][0]["question"]="May the run spend 20 USD?"; json.dump(j,open(f,"w")); p=r("check"); sys.exit("an agent answer that a later rule makes blocking is an error: "+p.stdout[-200:] if p.returncode!=0 else 0)

notes: SP-lmpjclxz close: the first landing of ST-xl4w2pmg stopped at the sync gate's backlog check with errors=2 on ST-57o3hmbo of another session (gate g1, answered by agent, now blocking because its options name paths outside its touches) until that item landed. The check edits a throwaway item file by hand to stand for a rule change, which no command can make.
